name: Dark Dungeon Feminized
detailed_description:
Story background

[Theta Foundation] is a laboratory with the highest security level deep underground, specially set up to contain and study [weird monsters]. After experiencing a system crash, the laboratory, which was closed according to the emergency protocol, became the darkest dungeon

You will play the role of a special agent who survived the crash and try your best to escape from here

As the exit gets closer, the monster will become more and more crazy

Don't be deceived by the appearance of the monster

In order to protect your sanity from being eroded, you are implanted with a [cognitive filter] - but while it saves you from madness, it also distorts your senses, making the creepy monster look like a gorgeous beauty, but a monster is still a monster...

[Consciousness Network] and gun modification

[Consciousness Network] is a powerful black box technology that can modify reality and cognition to achieve the magical ability to create things out of thin air. Your resources are very limited, and you must obtain the necessary supplies by exploring the [Consciousness Network]...right?

By modifying your guns, you can give yourself stronger firepower. Even the cruelest monsters are afraid of real bullets...

Battle with pigeon elements and strategy

In the randomly unlocked items, choose the right combination to create your unique fighting style. Point shooting, execution, melee, sweeping... More unique PEAK are waiting for you to combine

Features:

  • Customizable female villain

  • Use firearms and melee combat

  • Features and upgrades

  • Unlockable content

  • Dark but hopeful story

short_description: This FPS game has dark and beautiful art style. A tragic accident turns the strict laboratory into a dark dungeon. You are trying to escape from here with wisdom and strategy, and discover its unknown dark secrets.（Has Customizable female villain with costume damage）
